meta.name: Ensure Amazon SageMaker Notebook Instance only allows for IMDSv2
meta.description: Ensure Amazon SageMaker Notebook Instance only allows for IMDSv2
meta.remediation: Set instance_metadata_service_configuration { minimum_instance_metadata_service_version = "2" } on every aws_sagemaker_notebook_instance.

evaluators.description: instance_metadata_service_configuration.0.minimum_instance_metadata_service_version must be the string "2". An absent block makes the path unresolvable (severity 2) and fails at error_tolerance 1.
